item.title: Chattanooga Area Food Bank to hold special food distribution in Dalton - WDEF
item.description: The Chattanooga Area Food Bank will be holding a special food distribution in Dalton, Georgia on Saturday, March 14th from 8 a.m. to 11 a.m.

item.title: Trump administration bans import of new foreign-made routers, citing supply chain and security risks - WDEF
item.description: The Trump administration has banned imports of new, foreign-made routers citing supply chain vulnerability and cybersecurity risks.

item.title: Floyd County Courthouse closed Tuesday after fire damages historic building - WDEF
item.description: A catastrophic fire that heavily damaged the historic Floyd County Courthouse has forced court closures and disrupted government operations across the county.

item.title: Georgia woman charged in abortion case granted bond as questions grow over murder charge - WDEF
item.description: A Georgia woman facing a rare murder charge tied to an alleged abortion has been granted bond.

item.title: Now a true pop star, Miley Cyrus returns to her ‘Hannah Montana’ roots to fete anniversary special - WDEF
item.description: Sporting that “Hannah Montana” blond hair and bangs, Miley Cyrus went back to her roots — celebrating 20 years of the TV show that launched the career of a real-life pop star.

item.title: 87-year-old woman dies in crash on North Lee Highway - WDEF
item.description: An 87-year-old woman has died following a crash on North Lee Highway at King Den Drive on Monday, March 23, 2026.

item.title: Flying snake, pit viper among rare and new species discovered in cave in Cambodia - WDEF
item.description: Researchers have discovered multiple rare and new species in previously unexplored caves in Cambodia, including a flying snake and a florescent-turquoise pit viper.

item.title: Authorities find 229 migrants calling for help in back of truck in Mexico - WDEF
item.description: Mexican authorities found 229 migrants on Monday packed in the back of a truck traveling through the eastern Mexican state of Veracruz, the first such encounter in months, marking a potential uptick in migration since President Donald Trump took office.

item.title: A pink veil across the fields: Thousands flock to Greece’s peach blossoms - WDEF
item.description: Each spring, a pink veil unfolds across the plains of Greece’s largest peach-producing region. The blossoming peach trees create a spectacular sight that attracts visitors every year, mostly from Greece but increasingly also from the rest of Europe.
